business_problem: Games24x7, India’s leading multi-game platform, is a technology-driven company with the operating ethos of “Science of Gaming.” With a diverse portfolio of online skill games including RummyCircle, the country’s largest online rummy platform, and My11Circle, India’s second-largest fantasy sports platform, Games24x7 caters to an extensive user base of over 100 million players. Games24x7 is committed to enhancing the user experience by harnessing the power of data, behavioral science and artificial intelligence to deliver highly engaging experiences that are hyper-personalized to the needs of every single player in a very diverse population.
solution_summary: Games24x7, India’s leading multi-game platform, is a technology-driven company with the operating ethos of “Science of Gaming.” With a diverse portfolio of online skill games including RummyCircle, the country’s largest online rummy platform, and My11Circle, India’s second-largest fantasy sports platform, Games24x7 caters to an extensive user base of over 100 million players. Games24x7 partnered with Databricks to enrich the experience of its growing user base. This collaboration led to the creation of a unified platform for streamlining data operations, unifying data from disparate sources and automating data pipelines for scale, thereby guaranteeing a consistent and dependable data flow across individuals, teams, systems and business functions.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, and access controls across shared data assets.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks, is transformed in the lakehouse under Unity Catalog governance.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 20% Lower operational costs for BI workloads; 16% Faster performance of fraud prediction model.
